description: Foundation layer the 12 screens depend on: three new shadcn/ui primitives (table/select/tabs) with their Radix deps, shared formatting helpers, shared data components (ResourceTable + loading/error/empty states + StatusBadge), the current-study context (StudyProvider + useCurrentStudy), the header StudySwitcher, and the PageHeader — all wired into the _app shell. This feature is a prerequisite for FEAT-002 (every screen renders ResourceTable/PageHeader and reads useCurrentStudy). It leaves the app buildable: the switcher appears in the header and the dashboard/studies pages keep working, with no screen bindings changed yet. Grounded in design.md sections 'Current-study context', 'Reusable building blocks', 'shadcn/ui primitives to add'.
steps: Add formatting helpers to src/lib/utils.ts (keep existing cn): `formatDate(iso?: string | null): string` returns '—' for null/undefined else `new Date(iso).toLocaleString()`; `formatBytes(n?: number): string` returns '—' for null/undefined else a B/KB/MB/GB-formatted string.

Add src/components/ui/table.tsx: hand-authored new-york shadcn table over plain <table> elements with data-slot attributes and cn(); export Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableRow, TableHead, TableCell, TableCaption. No new dependency.

Add src/components/ui/select.tsx on @radix-ui/react-select (new-york style, data-slot, cn, cva where upstream uses it); export Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem, SelectSeparator.
Add src/components/ui/tabs.tsx on @radix-ui/react-tabs; export Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent.

Edit package.json dependencies: add "@radix-ui/react-select": "^2.1.2" and "@radix-ui/react-tabs": "^1.1.1" (caret ranges matching existing Radix 1.x entries), then run `npm install` so the lockfile updates before building.

Add src/components/data/states.tsx: TableLoadingState({ columns, rows=5 }) rendering skeleton TableRows; ErrorState({ error, resourceLabel }) a Card with text-destructive title 'Could not load {resourceLabel}' and 401-specific copy (error?.response?.status === 401 ? 'Not authenticated...' : error?.message ?? 'Request failed.'); EmptyState({ title, description, icon? }) a Card with optional lucide icon. Type the error prop `error: AxiosError | null` imported from 'axios'.

Add src/components/data/status-badge.tsx: StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string }) with case-insensitive map active/approved->default, archived/retired->secondary, draft/pending->outline, failed/error->destructive, else secondary; renders <Badge variant=...>{status}</Badge>.

Add src/components/data/resource-table.tsx: generic ResourceColumn<T> ({ key: string; header: string; cell?: (row: T) => React.ReactNode; className?: string }) and ResourceTableProps<T> ({ columns; rows: T[] | undefined; getRowId: (row: T) => string; isLoading: boolean; isError: boolean; error: AxiosError | null; resourceLabel: string; emptyState?: React.ReactNode; onRowClick?: (row: T) => void }). Implement the strict four-way switch: isLoading -> table header + TableLoadingState; isError -> <ErrorState error resourceLabel/>; loaded & rows.length===0 -> emptyState ?? <EmptyState title={`No ${resourceLabel} yet`}/>; loaded & rows -> table primitive wrapped in a `rounded-md border` container, keyed by getRowId, each cell `column.cell?.(row) ?? String((row as any)[column.key] ?? '—')`; apply column.className to TableHead/TableCell; when onRowClick set, add `cursor-pointer hover:bg-muted/50` to rows.

Add src/components/study-provider.tsx: const STUDY_KEY = 'aurinara.currentStudy'; StudyProvider calls useListStudies(); tracks currentStudyId in useState initialized from localStorage (try/catch, degrade to in-memory per src/lib/auth.ts); on studies load, if persisted id exists in data.items keep it, else default to data.items[0] and rewrite storage; setCurrentStudyId updates state + storage together. Expose useCurrentStudy() -> { studies: data?.items ?? [], currentStudy, currentStudyId, setCurrentStudyId, isLoading, isError }; throw if used outside provider (mirror useAuth). Add `// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components` above useCurrentStudy.

Add src/components/layout/study-switcher.tsx built on the select primitive: options = studies.map(s => ({ value: s.id, label: `${s.code} — ${s.name}` })); onValueChange calls setCurrentStudyId; isLoading -> <Skeleton className='h-9 w-48'/>; zero studies -> disabled trigger 'No studies'; selected -> trigger shows current code+name truncated; carries its own max-w + truncation.

Add src/components/layout/page-header.tsx: PageHeader({ title, description?, actions? }) rendering `<div className='flex items-start justify-between gap-4'>` with an h1 (text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight) + optional muted description paragraph, and an optional right-aligned actions slot.

Modify src/routes/_app.tsx: wrap the existing shell (SidebarProvider -> AppSidebar + SidebarInset -> Header -> content Outlet) in <StudyProvider> inside AppLayout. Do NOT change the beforeLoad auth guard.
Modify src/components/layout/header.tsx: import and render <StudySwitcher /> immediately before the `ml-auto` cluster div (always visible, not under the search box's `md:` responsive gating).
acceptance_criteria: `npm install` completes and package.json lists @radix-ui/react-select and @radix-ui/react-tabs.
`npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) completes with zero TypeScript errors.
`npm run lint` reports zero errors (pre-existing 3 react-refresh warnings may remain; no new errors).

The nine new files exist (ui/table.tsx, ui/select.tsx, ui/tabs.tsx, data/states.tsx, data/status-badge.tsx, data/resource-table.tsx, study-provider.tsx, layout/study-switcher.tsx, layout/page-header.tsx) and src/routes/_app.tsx wraps the shell in StudyProvider with the beforeLoad guard unchanged.
No file under src/api/generated/** and not src/routeTree.gen.ts was modified.
The study switcher renders in the header and the dashboard (/) and studies (/studies) pages still render.
verification: From frontend/: run `npm install` then `npm run build` and confirm zero type errors.
From frontend/: run `npm run lint` and confirm zero errors.
Confirm via git status / diff that no src/api/generated/** file and not src/routeTree.gen.ts changed.
findings:
Foundation layer implemented and verified (npm run build: 0 type errors; npm run lint: 0 errors, only the 3 pre-existing react-refresh warnings in badge.tsx/button.tsx/sidebar.tsx). No src/api/generated/** file and not src/routeTree.gen.ts was touched. API surface FEAT-002 depends on:

ResourceTable (src/components/data/resource-table.tsx) — exported component `ResourceTable<T>` plus exported interfaces `ResourceColumn<T>` ({ key: string; header: string; cell?: (row: T) => React.ReactNode; className?: string }) and `ResourceTableProps<T>` ({ columns: ResourceColumn<T>[]; rows: T[] | undefined; getRowId: (row: T) => string; isLoading: boolean; isError: boolean; error: AxiosError | null; resourceLabel: string; emptyState?: React.ReactNode; onRowClick?: (row: T) => void }). Strict render order: isError -> ErrorState; isLoading -> header + skeleton rows; empty -> emptyState ?? default EmptyState; else table. Default cell renders String(row[key] ?? '—'). Import the error type as `import type { AxiosError } from 'axios'` and pass hook `error` through with NO cast (ErrorType<HTTPValidationError> = AxiosError<HTTPValidationError> assigns to AxiosError<unknown, any>).

States (src/components/data/states.tsx) — exports `TableLoadingState({ columns: number; rows?: number })`, `ErrorState({ error: AxiosError | null; resourceLabel: string })`, `EmptyState({ title: string; description?: React.ReactNode; icon?: LucideIcon })`. For a scoped screen's no-study case, pass an `<EmptyState title="No study selected" description="Create a study first to view its {resource}." />` via ResourceTable's `emptyState` prop.

StatusBadge (src/components/data/status-badge.tsx) — `StatusBadge({ status }: { status: string })`; case-insensitive map active/approved->default, archived/retired->secondary, draft/pending->outline, failed/error->destructive, else secondary.

StudyProvider / useCurrentStudy (src/components/study-provider.tsx) — `useCurrentStudy()` returns { studies: StudyResponse[]; currentStudy: StudyResponse | null; currentStudyId: string | null; setCurrentStudyId: (id: string) => void; isLoading: boolean; isError: boolean }. Throws outside the provider. localStorage key `aurinara.currentStudy`. Scoped screens call their hook with `currentStudyId ?? ''` and `{ query: { enabled: !!currentStudyId } }`.

PageHeader (src/components/layout/page-header.tsx) — `PageHeader({ title: string; description?: React.ReactNode; actions?: React.ReactNode })`.

UI primitives added: src/components/ui/table.tsx (Table, TableHeader, TableBody, TableFooter, TableHead, TableRow, TableCell, TableCaption), src/components/ui/select.tsx (Select, SelectGroup, SelectValue, SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectLabel, SelectItem, SelectSeparator, plus SelectScrollUpButton/SelectScrollDownButton), src/components/ui/tabs.tsx (Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent). Formatting helpers in src/lib/utils.ts: `formatDate(iso?: string | null)` and `formatBytes(n?: number | null)`, both return '—' for null/undefined. StudySwitcher mounted in header.tsx before the ml-auto cluster; StudyProvider wraps the shell in _app.tsx (beforeLoad guard unchanged). Note for FEAT-002: module-placeholder.tsx is still present and referenced by the 12 placeholder routes; delete it only after the last route is migrated to avoid a dangling import.
